prefix.description: SEL-501 Dual Overcurrent Relay (model digits, ordered as 0-5-0-1)

part_number.note: 14-character Model Option Table from WI-1022, the SEL-501-0/-2 Connectorized (plug-in connector) ordering doc. Position 6 is the fixed connectorized designator 'W' (the improved plug-in connector design; the older Connectorized design was 'J'). Position 5 selects firmware/application settings and distinguishes the SEL-501-0 (code 0) from the SEL-501-2 (code 2). The 'Secondary Input Current; Frequency; Phase Rotation' section is split across three non-adjacent columns: current (8) and frequency (9) are adjacent, while phase rotation (13) is a trailing character after the packaging/protocol columns. No full real part number was available; positions are anchored to the WI-1022 MOT figure (this device has no drawing layers).
references: SEL-501/SEL-501-1 Instruction Manual (501-0-1_IM_20250131) - partial part numbers 0501xW / 0501xJ
